violations.plain: Gutter grates broken/missing, or skimmer missing weir, lid or clean basket.

violations.official: Rules Posted. 64E-9.004(4); 64E-9.008(6) & (13)(f). Signs shall be maintained legible from the pool deck as approved by the jurisdictional building department addressing: bathing load, pool operation time, no-diving, animals, glass, food/beverages, showering, swimming while ill, swallowing pool water, and additionally for spa pools: temperature, spa use time, minimum age, and vulnerable person caution.
violations.plain: Required pool rules signs missing or illegible.

violations.official: Lifeguard/Instructor/Pool Technician Certification. 64E-9.008(2); 64E-9.018. If lifeguards or swimming instructors are provided, they must be certified by the American Red Cross, YMCA, or other nationally recognized aquatic training program. Swimming instructors must also be first aid and CPR certified; and swimming instructors of developmentally disabled students must also be certified in accordance with section 514.072, F.S. Proof of a certification is required at the pool site. Unless exempt under section 514.075, F.S., pool service technicians shall be certified under a DOH approved course.
violations.plain: Lifeguard, swim instructor or pool service technician certification missing or not proven on site.

violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). All pools must have an approved test kit on site capable of testing free chlorine (with DPD reagent), combined chlorine, pH, calcium hardness and total alkalinity. Pools utilizing chlorine generators must have a sodium chloride test kit. Pools using quaternary ammonium compounds must have a quaternary ammonium test kit. Pools using chlorine stabilizer must have a cyanuric acid test kit. NSF 50 certified halogen test strips may only be used for an Epsom salt (MgSO4) tank.
violations.plain: Approved water test kit missing or incomplete for the chemicals used.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine. Spa pools & IWFs must maintain 2-10 mg/L free chlorine, or 3-10mg/L bromine. The maximum disinfectant level for indoor conventional swimming pools is 5 mg/L chlorine or 6 mg/L bromine. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.
violations.plain: Free chlorine/bromine outside required range (pool use must be prohibited until corrected).

violations.official: Disinfection Feeder. 64E-9.008(10)(e); 64E-9.017(1). A properly sized disinfection feeder and/or generator shall be provided. Electrical pumps must be electrically interlocked with the recirculation pump. Feeders/generators must be certified under NSF/ANSI 50.
violations.plain: Disinfection feeder/generator missing, undersized, not interlocked with the pump, or not NSF/ANSI 50 certified.

violations.official: pH Feeder. 64E-9.008(10)(e); 64E-9.017(1). pH adjustment feeders must be provided on all pools, and must be electrically interlocked with the recirculation pump.
violations.plain: pH feeder missing or not interlocked with the recirculation pump.

violations.official: Chemical Container/Labeled. FBC 454.1.6.5.16.2 & .3. Solution reservoirs shall have at least 50 percent storage capacity of the solution pump and shall be labeled.
violations.plain: Chemical solution reservoir too small or not labeled.

violations.official: Flowmeter. 64E-9.008(10)(b); FBC 454.1.6.5.13. All pools shall have a functional flowmeter capable of reading from 1/2 to 1&1/2 the design flow rate.
violations.plain: Flowmeter missing or not functional.

violations.plain: Required pool rules signs missing or illegible.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine. Spa pools & IWFs must maintain 2-10 mg/L free chlorine, or 3-10mg/L bromine. The maximum disinfectant level for indoor conventional swimming pools is 5 mg/L chlorine or 6 mg/L bromine. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.

violations.official: Water Level/Control. 64E-9.004(6); FBC 454.1.6.5.11. The pool water level shall be maintained for continuous skimming flow during periods of non-use. A manual and automatic fill device shall be provided and shall discharge into the collector tank.

violations.official: Disinfection Feeder. 64E-9.008(10)(e); 64E-9.017(1). A properly sized disinfection feeder and/or generator shall be provided. Electrical pumps must be electrically interlocked with the recirculation pump. Feeders/generators must be certified under NSF/ANSI 50.

violations.official: pH Feeder. 64E-9.008(10)(e); 64E-9.017(1). pH adjustment feeders must be provided on all pools, and must be electrically interlocked with the recirculation pump.
violations.plain: pH feeder missing or not interlocked with the recirculation pump.

violations.official: Pressure/Vacuum Gauges. 64E-9.008(10)(d). All vacuum filter systems shall have a functional vacuum gauge before the pump. All pressure filter systems shall have a functional pressure gauge mounted before and after the filter.
violations.plain: Required vacuum/pressure gauge missing or not functional.

violations.official: Maintenance Log. 64E-9.004(10). Daily record must be kept for pH and disinfectant residual tested each day the pool is open for use, and weekly for Cyanuric Acid.
violations.plain: Daily pH/disinfectant log (and weekly cyanuric acid) not kept.

violations.official: Safety-514.0315(2), F.S. 64E-9.008(3)(a) & (10)(c); 64E-9.017(1)(e) & (g). violations.official: Rules Posted. 64E-9.004(4); 64E-9.008(6) & (13)(f). violations.official: Lifeguard/Instructor/Pool Technician Certification. 64E-9.008(2); 64E-9.018. Swimming instructors must also be first aid and CPR certified; and swimming instructors of developmentally disabled students must also be certified in accordance with section 514.072, F.S. violations.plain: Lifeguard, swim instructor or pool service technician certification missing or not proven on site.

violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). All pools must have an approved test kit on site capable of testing free chlorine (with DPD reagent), combined chlorine, pH, calcium hardness and total alkalinity. Pools using chlorine stabilizer must have a cyanuric acid test kit. NSF 50 certified halogen test strips may only be used for an Epsom salt (MgSO4) tank.
violations.plain: Approved water test kit missing or incomplete for the chemicals used.

violations.official: Flowmeter. 64E-9.008(10)(b); FBC 454.1.6.5.13. All pools shall have a functional flowmeter capable of reading from 1/2 to 1&1/2 the design flow rate.

violations.plain: Required vacuum/pressure gauge missing or not functional.

violations.official: Rules Posted. 64E-9.004(4); 64E-9.008(6) & (13)(f). violations.official: Lifeguard/Instructor/Pool Technician Certification. 64E-9.008(2); 64E-9.018. If lifeguards or swimming instructors are provided, they must be certified by the American Red Cross, YMCA, or other nationally recognized aquatic training program. Swimming instructors must also be first aid and CPR certified; and swimming instructors of developmentally disabled students must also be certified in accordance with section 514.072, F.S. Proof of a certification is required at the pool site. Unless exempt under section 514.075, F.S., pool service technicians shall be certified under a DOH approved course.
violations.plain: Lifeguard, swim instructor or pool service technician certification missing or not proven on site.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine. Spa pools & IWFs must maintain 2-10 mg/L free chlorine, or 3-10mg/L bromine. The maximum disinfectant level for indoor conventional swimming pools is 5 mg/L chlorine or 6 mg/L bromine. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.
violations.plain: Free chlorine/bromine outside required range (pool use must be prohibited until corrected).

violations.official: Cross Connection. 64E-9.004(l)(a). An air gap must be provided in the fill line and in the waste line. Vacuum breakers shall be provided on all hose bibbs in the sanitary facilities, pool area and equipment room area.

violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). All pools must have an approved test kit on site capable of testing free chlorine (with DPD reagent), combined chlorine, pH, calcium hardness and total alkalinity. Pools utilizing chlorine generators must have a sodium chloride test kit. Pools using quaternary ammonium compounds must have a quaternary ammonium test kit. Pools using chlorine stabilizer must have a cyanuric acid test kit. NSF 50 certified halogen test strips may only be used for an Epsom salt (MgSO4) tank.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine. Spa pools & IWFs must maintain 2-10 mg/L free chlorine, or 3-10mg/L bromine. The maximum disinfectant level for indoor conventional swimming pools is 5 mg/L chlorine or 6 mg/L bromine. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.

violations.official: Gutter Grates/Skimmer. FBC 454.1.6.5.3.1 & 2. Gutter drains must be covered by a fully intact grate. Skimmers must have a weir in place, deck cover secured in place and the basket must be in place and clean.

violations.official: Rules Posted. 64E-9.004(4); 64E-9.008(6) & (13)(f). Signs shall be maintained legible from the pool deck as approved by the jurisdictional building department addressing: bathing load, pool operation time, no-diving, animals, glass, food/beverages, showering, swimming while ill, swallowing pool water, and additionally for spa pools: temperature, spa use time, minimum age, and vulnerable person caution.
violations.plain: Required pool rules signs missing or illegible.

violations.official: Fences/Gates: FBC 454.1.3.1.9; 454.1.5.1 & 2. Pools approved after May 2004 code revision shall have a minimum height fence, with no breaches, and with operable selfclosing, self-latching gates. Equipment and chlorine gas area fence/gate shall be secure and locked. Wading and specialty pool fences/gates shall be sustained as installed.
violations.plain: Fence or gate breached, too short, not self-closing/latching, or equipment/chlorine area not locked.

lead_reasons: Repeat problems: 2 failed/closed inspection dates in history

violations.official: Handrail/Ladder. FBC 454.1.2.5.1 & .5 Handrails must be provided for all pool steps and must be securely anchored in the pool deck and the bottom step. “Figure Four” handrails must be securely anchored in the pool deck and must extend to above the bottom step. Ladders must be provided and must be securely anchored in the pool deck and must rest against the pool wall with a 3 to 6 inch clearance.
violations.plain: Handrails or ladders missing, loose, or not properly anchored/positioned.

violations.official: Suction Outlet Covers. Section 514.0315(1), F.S.; 64E-9.008(3)(a) & (10)(c); 64E-9.017(1)(e) & (g). violations.official: Pool Side Shower. FBC 454.1.6.2. All outdoor pools must have a rinse shower located on the pool deck within perimeter of the fence. POOL SAFETY

violations.official: Lifeguard/Instructor/Pool Technician Certification. 64E-9.008(2); 64E-9.018. violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). Pools using chlorine stabilizer must have a cyanuric acid test kit. NSF 50 certified halogen test strips may only be used for an Epsom salt (MgSO4) tank.
violations.plain: Approved water test kit missing or incomplete for the chemicals used.

violations.official: Flowmeter. 64E-9.008(10)(b); FBC 454.1.6.5.13. All pools shall have a functional flowmeter capable of reading from 1/2 to 1&1/2 the design flow rate.

violations.plain: Required vacuum/pressure gauge missing or not functional.

violations.official: Cross Connection. 64E-9.004(l)(a). An air gap must be provided in the fill line and in the waste line. Vacuum breakers shall be provided on all hose bibbs in the sanitary facilities, pool area and equipment room area.

violations.plain: Daily pH/disinfectant log (and weekly cyanuric acid) not kept.

violations.official: Life Hook with Pole. 64E-9.008(3). A shepherd’s hook securely attached to a one piece pole not less than 16 feet long must be provided. violations.official: Rules Posted. 64E-9.004(4); 64E-9.008(6) & (13)(f). violations.plain: Required pool rules signs missing or illegible.

violations.official: Lifeguard/Instructor/Pool Technician Certification. 64E-9.008(2); 64E-9.018. violations.plain: Lifeguard, swim instructor or pool service technician certification missing or not proven on site.

violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). All pools must have an approved test kit on site capable of testing free chlorine (with DPD reagent), combined chlorine, pH, calcium hardness and total alkalinity. violations.plain: Approved water test kit missing or incomplete for the chemicals used.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). violations.plain: Flowmeter missing or not functional.

violations.official: Pressure/Vacuum Gauges. 64E-9.008(10)(d). All vacuum filter systems shall have a functional vacuum gauge before the pump. All pressure filter systems shall have a functional pressure gauge mounted before and after the filter.

violations.official: Handrail/Ladder. violations.plain: Handrails or ladders missing, loose, or not properly anchored/positioned.

violations.official: Step Markings. FBC 454.1.2.5.3. All step edges must have a 2 inch contrasting marking on the tread and riser (3/4 inch by 2 inch bullnose tile may be substituted) which shall extend the full length of each step and be slip resistant. Tile used on horizontal surfaces of steps, treads, benches, deck, markers and swimouts must be slip resistant.
violations.plain: Step edges lack required 2-inch contrasting, slip-resistant markings, or step/deck tile not slip resistant.

violations.official: Suction Outlet Covers. Section 514.0315(1), F.S.; 64E-9.008(3)(a) & (10)(c); 64E-9.017(1)(e) & (g). All suction outlet covers/ grates shall be maintained as properly secured, intact, tested, reported to DOH on Verification form DH4157, and in compliance with the national anti-entrapment standard cited in section 514.0315(1), F.S.
violations.plain: Suction outlet (drain) covers not secured, intact, tested, reported to DOH (form DH4157), or not meeting the anti-entrapment standard.

violations.official: Life Hook with Pole. 64E-9.008(3). A shepherd’s hook securely attached to a one piece pole not less than 16 feet long must be provided. The life hook must be fully accessible and visible from the pool. Pools over 50 feet in length must have a shepherd’s hook along each of the longer sides of the pool.
violations.plain: Shepherd's hook on 16-ft one-piece pole missing, not accessible/visible, or not on each long side of large pools.

violations.official: Life Ring with Rope. 64E-9.008(3). An 18 inch diameter lifesaving ring with sufficient rope attached to reach all parts of the pool must be provided. The rope must be in good condition. The ring must be fully accessible, visible and not tied down or locked. Pools over 50 feet in length must have a lifesaving ring along each of the longer sides of the pool.
violations.plain: 18-inch life ring with rope missing, worn, tied down, or not on each long side of large pools.

violations.official: Rules Posted. 64E-9.004(4); 64E-9.008(6) & (13)(f). Signs shall be maintained legible from the pool deck as approved by the jurisdictional building department addressing: bathing load, pool operation time, no-diving, animals, glass, food/beverages, showering, swimming while ill, swallowing pool water, and additionally for spa pools: temperature, spa use time, minimum age, and vulnerable person caution.
violations.plain: Required pool rules signs missing or illegible.

violations.official: Lifeguard/Instructor/Pool Technician Certification. 64E-9.008(2); 64E-9.018. If lifeguards or swimming instructors are provided, they must be certified by the American Red Cross, YMCA, or other nationally recognized aquatic training program. Swimming instructors must also be first aid and CPR certified; and swimming instructors of developmentally disabled students must also be certified in accordance with section 514.072, F.S. Proof of a certification is required at the pool site. Unless exempt under section 514.075, F.S., pool service technicians shall be certified under a DOH approved course.
violations.plain: Lifeguard, swim instructor or pool service technician certification missing or not proven on site.

violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). All pools must have an approved test kit on site capable of testing free chlorine (with DPD reagent), combined chlorine, pH, calcium hardness and total alkalinity. Pools utilizing chlorine generators must have a sodium chloride test kit. Pools using quaternary ammonium compounds must have a quaternary ammonium test kit. violations.official: Equipment Change. FBC 454.1.10. All equipment changes must have prior approval from the jurisdictional building department when they have jurisdiction, or the DOH.

violations.official: Maintenance Log. 64E-9.004(10). Daily record must be kept for pH and disinfectant residual tested each day the pool is open for use, and weekly for Cyanuric Acid.
violations.plain: Daily pH/disinfectant log (and weekly cyanuric acid) not kept.

violations.official: Safety-514.0315(2), F.S. 64E-9.008(3)(a) & (10)(c); 64E-9.017(1)(e) & (g). violations.official: Life Hook with Pole. 64E-9.008(3). A shepherd’s hook securely attached to a one piece pole not less than 16 feet long must be provided. violations.plain: Shepherd's hook on 16-ft one-piece pole missing, not accessible/visible, or not on each long side of large pools.

violations.official: Life Ring with Rope. 64E-9.008(3). An 18 inch diameter lifesaving ring with sufficient rope attached to reach all parts of the pool must be provided. violations.plain: 18-inch life ring with rope missing, worn, tied down, or not on each long side of large pools.

violations.official: Rules Posted. 64E-9.004(4); 64E-9.008(6) & (13)(f). Signs shall be maintained legible from the pool deck as approved by the jurisdictional building department addressing: bathing load, pool operation time, no-diving, animals, glass, food/beverages, showering, swimming while ill, swallowing pool water, and additionally for spa pools: temperature, spa use time, minimum age, and vulnerable person caution.
violations.plain: Required pool rules signs missing or illegible.

violations.official: Lifeguard/Instructor/Pool Technician Certification. 64E-9.008(2); 64E-9.018. violations.plain: Lifeguard, swim instructor or pool service technician certification missing or not proven on site.

violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). All pools must have an approved test kit on site capable of testing free chlorine (with DPD reagent), combined chlorine, pH, calcium hardness and total alkalinity. Pools utilizing chlorine generators must have a sodium chloride test kit. Pools using quaternary ammonium compounds must have a quaternary ammonium test kit. Pools using chlorine stabilizer must have a cyanuric acid test kit. NSF 50 certified halogen test strips may only be used for an Epsom salt (MgSO4) tank.
violations.plain: Approved water test kit missing or incomplete for the chemicals used.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine. Spa pools & IWFs must maintain 2-10 mg/L free chlorine, or 3-10mg/L bromine. The maximum disinfectant level for indoor conventional swimming pools is 5 mg/L chlorine or 6 mg/L bromine. violations.official: pH. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). The pH in all pools shall be maintained between 7.2 and 7.8, inclusive. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.

violations.official: Pressure/Vacuum Gauges. 64E-9.008(10)(d). All vacuum filter systems shall have a functional vacuum gauge before the pump. All pressure filter systems shall have a functional pressure gauge mounted before and after the filter.

violations.official: Equipment Change. FBC 454.1.10. All equipment changes must have prior approval from the jurisdictional building department when they have jurisdiction, or the DOH.
violations.plain: Equipment changed without prior building department/DOH approval.

violations.plain: Required pool rules signs missing or illegible.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine. Spa pools & IWFs must maintain 2-10 mg/L free chlorine, or 3-10mg/L bromine. The maximum disinfectant level for indoor conventional swimming pools is 5 mg/L chlorine or 6 mg/L bromine. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.
violations.plain: Free chlorine/bromine outside required range (pool use must be prohibited until corrected).

violations.official: Handrail/Ladder. FBC 454.1.2.5.1 & .5 Handrails must be provided for all pool steps and must be securely anchored in the pool deck and the bottom step. “Figure Four” handrails must be securely anchored in the pool deck and must extend to above the bottom step. violations.plain: Handrails or ladders missing, loose, or not properly anchored/positioned.

violations.official: Step Markings. FBC 454.1.2.5.3. All step edges must have a 2 inch contrasting marking on the tread and riser (3/4 inch by 2 inch bullnose tile may be substituted) which shall extend the full length of each step and be slip resistant. Tile used on horizontal surfaces of steps, treads, benches, deck, markers and swimouts must be slip resistant.
violations.plain: Step edges lack required 2-inch contrasting, slip-resistant markings, or step/deck tile not slip resistant.

violations.official: Suction Outlet Covers. Section 514.0315(1), F.S.; 64E-9.008(3)(a) & (10)(c); 64E-9.017(1)(e) & (g). violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). violations.plain: Approved water test kit missing or incomplete for the chemicals used.

violations.official: Handrail/Ladder. violations.official: Gutter Grates/Skimmer. FBC 454.1.6.5.3.1 & 2. Gutter drains must be covered by a fully intact grate. Skimmers must have a weir in place, deck cover secured in place and the basket must be in place and clean.

violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). All pools must have an approved test kit on site capable of testing free chlorine (with DPD reagent), combined chlorine, pH, calcium hardness and total alkalinity. violations.official: Pressure/Vacuum Gauges. 64E-9.008(10)(d). All vacuum filter systems shall have a functional vacuum gauge before the pump. All pressure filter systems shall have a functional pressure gauge mounted before and after the filter.

violations.official: Equipment Change. FBC 454.1.10. All equipment changes must have prior approval from the jurisdictional building department when they have jurisdiction, or the DOH.

violations.official: Approved Test Kit. 64E-9.004(9). violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine. Spa pools & IWFs must maintain 2-10 mg/L free chlorine, or 3-10mg/L bromine. The maximum disinfectant level for indoor conventional swimming pools is 5 mg/L chlorine or 6 mg/L bromine. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.

Pools utilizing chlorine generators must have a sodium chloride test kit. Pools using quaternary ammonium compounds must have a quaternary ammonium test kit. Pools using chlorine stabilizer must have a cyanuric acid test kit. NSF 50 certified halogen test strips may only be used for an Epsom salt (MgSO4) tank.
violations.plain: Approved water test kit missing or incomplete for the chemicals used.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine. Spa pools & IWFs must maintain 2-10 mg/L free chlorine, or 3-10mg/L bromine. The maximum disinfectant level for indoor conventional swimming pools is 5 mg/L chlorine or 6 mg/L bromine. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.
violations.plain: Free chlorine/bromine outside required range (pool use must be prohibited until corrected).

violations.official: pH. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). The pH in all pools shall be maintained between 7.2 and 7.8, inclusive. Pool owner must prohibit pool use when water quality is outside these parameters.
violations.plain: pH outside 7.2-7.8 (pool use must be prohibited until corrected).

violations.official: Water Level/Control. 64E-9.004(6); FBC 454.1.6.5.11. The pool water level shall be maintained for continuous skimming flow during periods of non-use. A manual and automatic fill device shall be provided and shall discharge into the collector tank.
violations.plain: Water level too low for continuous skimming, or manual/automatic fill device missing.

violations.official: pH Feeder. 64E-9.008(10)(e); 64E-9.017(1). pH adjustment feeders must be provided on all pools, and must be electrically interlocked with the recirculation pump.

violations.official: Equipment Room Drainage/Vent/Lighting/Clean. 64E-9.008(10) & (13);FBC454.1.5.1-.9. Equipment room shall: have Drainage, ventilation, lighting and be clutter free.

violations.official: Cross Connection. 64E-9.004(l)(a). An air gap must be provided in the fill line and in the waste line. Vacuum breakers shall be provided on all hose bibbs in the sanitary facilities, pool area and equipment room area.

violations.official: Life Hook with Pole. 64E-9.008(3). A shepherd’s hook securely attached to a one piece pole not less than 16 feet long must be provided. The life hook must be fully accessible and visible from the pool. Pools over 50 feet in length must have a shepherd’s hook along each of the longer sides of the pool.

violations.official: Life Ring with Rope. 64E-9.008(3). An 18 inch diameter lifesaving ring with sufficient rope attached to reach all parts of the pool must be provided. The rope must be in good condition. The ring must be fully accessible, visible and not tied down or locked. Pools over 50 feet in length must have a lifesaving ring along each of the longer sides of the pool.
violations.plain: 18-inch life ring with rope missing, worn, tied down, or not on each long side of large pools.

violations.official: Free Chlorine/Bromine. 64E-9.004(1); 64E-9.017(1). Free chlorine level must be between 1-10mg/L (parts per million) in conventional swimming pools, inclusive; or 1½10 ppm bromine.
